ei.title: A Parent Trap for Gifted Children
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: As the parent of a gifted child, you need to be aware of a certain common parent trap. Of course you are a proud parent, and you should be. While it is very easy to talk nonstop about your little genius and his or her remarkable behavior, this can be very stressful on your child. It is extremely important to limit your bragging behavior to your very close friends, or your parents. Gifted children feel pressured when their parents show them off too much. This behavior creates expectations that they may not be able to live up to, and also creates a false sense of self for your child. You want your child to be who they are, not who they seem to be as defined by their incredible achievements. If not, you could end up with a driven perfectionist child or perhaps a drop-out, or worse.

questions.passage: As the parent of a gifted child, you need to be (A)[aware / ignorant] of a certain common parent trap. Of course you are a (B)[ashamed / proud] parent, and you should be. While it is very easy to talk nonstop about your little genius and his or her remarkable behavior, this can be very (C)[relaxing / stressful] on your child. This behavior creates expectations that they may not be able to live up to, and also creates a false sense of self for your child. You want your child to be who they are, not who they seem to be as defined by their incredible achievements. If not, you could end up with a driven perfectionist child or perhaps a drop-out, or worse.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) aware=인지하는, (B) proud=자랑스러운, (C) stressful=스트레스가 많은
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignorant — proud — stressful: (A) ignorant(모르는)는 aware(인지하는)와 반대
✅ ② aware — proud — stressful: 원문 일치. 함정을 인지해야(aware) 하고, 자랑스러운(proud) 부모이며, 아이에게 스트레스가 될(stressful) 수 있다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ aware — ashamed — stressful: (B) ashamed(부끄러운)는 proud(자랑스러운)와 반대
❌ ④ aware — proud — relaxing: (C) relaxing(편안한)은 stressful(스트레스가 많은)과 반대
det.tip: be aware of a trap / a proud parent / very stressful on your child

❌ ② (A) 분별력 — (B) 의미: (A)는 방향 감각이 더 적절
✅ ③ (A) 감각 — (B) 의식/느낌: (A)는 방향 '감각(sense of direction)', (B)는 거짓된 자의식(sense of self)을 뜻하여 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 느낌 — (B) 방향: (B)의 sense는 방향이 아닌 자의식
det.tip: sense: ① (명사) 감각 ② (명사) 의식/느낌 ③ (명사) 분별력 ④ (동사) 감지하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a thing that someone has done successfully through effort"

det.korean: achievement=성취/업적 (노력을 통해 성공적으로 이뤄낸 것)
det.analysis:
✅ ① achievement(성취/업적): 노력을 통해 성공적으로 이뤄낸 것이라는 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② trap(함정): 벗어나기 힘든 상황으로 정의와 불일치
❌ ③ behavior(행동): 행동 방식으로 '성취'의 정의와 다름
❌ ④ expectation(기대): 앞으로 바라는 것으로 이미 이룬 성취와 다름
det.tip: achievement = 성취/업적 (something done successfully with effort)

questions.passage: You want your child to be who they are, not who they seem to be as defined by their incredible achievements. If not, you could end up with a __________ (drive) perfectionist child or perhaps a drop-out, or worse.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 동사 drive를 과거분사형 형용사 driven으로 변환 (명사 perfectionist 수식)
det.analysis: 관사 a와 명사구 perfectionist child 사이에 명사를 수식하는 형용사가 필요하다. 동사 drive의 과거분사 driven(성취욕에 이끌리는)으로 바꿔 perfectionist child를 수식한다. drive → driven
det.tip: drive → driven(과거분사형 형용사, 성취욕에 이끌리는). a driven perfectionist

questions.passage: You want your child to be who they are, not who they seem to be as __________ (define) by their incredible achievements. If not, you could end up with a driven perfectionist child or perhaps a drop-out, or worse.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 동사 define을 과거분사 defined로 변환 (as + 과거분사, 수동)
det.analysis: 'as __________ by their incredible achievements'에서 아이가 업적에 의해 '규정되는' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 defined가 필요하다. (as (they are) defined by ...). define → defined
det.tip: as defined by ~ = ~에 의해 규정되는 (수동, 과거분사)

questions.passage: As the parent of a gifted child, you need to be aware of a certain common parent trap. Of course you are a proud parent, and you should be. While it is very easy to talk nonstop about your little genius and his or her remarkable behavior, this can be very stressful on your child. It is extremely important to limit your bragging behavior to your very close friends, or your parents. Gifted children feel pressured when their parents __________. This behavior creates expectations that they may not be able to live up to, and also creates a false sense of self for your child. You want your child to be who they are, not who they seem to be as defined by their incredible achievements. If not, you could end up with a driven perfectionist child or perhaps a drop-out, or worse.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: show them off too much=그들을 지나치게 자랑하다 — 영재가 압박을 느끼는 원인
det.analysis:
❌ ① praise them very quietly(그들을 조용히 칭찬하다): 압박을 주는 지나친 과시와 반대
✅ ② show them off too much(그들을 지나치게 자랑하다): 원문 일치. 부모가 지나치게 자랑할 때 영재가 압박을 느낀다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ ignore them completely(그들을 완전히 무시하다): 과시와 반대
❌ ④ compare them quite fairly(그들을 공정하게 비교하다): 본문과 무관
det.tip: when their parents show them off too much — 부모가 지나치게 자랑할 때

det.korean: limit your bragging behavior=자랑하는 행동을 제한하다 — 아주 가까운 사람에게만으로 자랑을 제한하라는 맥락
